title: POTV ONE Dosing Capsules
description:
What is a dosing capsule?

A dosing capsule is a small metal container with a removable lid and a base. The lid is removed, and the base is filled with ground herbs. After the lid is reattached, the herb-filled capsule is dropped into the oven. Both ends are perforated to allow hot air to pass through, enabling vaporization to occur.

Easy, on-the-go vaping

Dosing capsules allow for the portioning out of herbs in the comfort of home, and quicker, stealthier reloading when on the go. Never worry about grinding herbs in public, or handling loose herbs in a strong wind. Each 4-pack comes with a carrying tube, for storing pre-filled capsules.

Prolong the life of your vaporizer

Using dosing capsules instead of placing your ground herbs directly into the oven will reduce wear and tear on your vape, allowing for less frequent deep cleans, and a clearer vapor path.

Standardize your doses

Each stainless steel capsule holds 0.1g of dried herbs, so using these dosing capsules is an easy way to keep track of your herb usage, and help to make your herbs go further.

Bundle up and save

Grab a set of dosing capsules with your Capsule Caddy Insert for POTV One and save!

Compatibility

These dosing capsules are designed to work with the Planet of the Vapes ONE, the POTV XMAX V3 Pro, and also the Fury 2, and all other iterations of the Fenix Mini.

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
